summary: Afghanistan’s agriculture pledge is to restore and develop irrigation systems until irrigated agricultural land reaches 3.14 M-ha, equivalent to about 48.4% of the country’s mapped 2022 agricultural area. For conservation, it aims to bring at least 10% of national land and selected species’ habitat under a conservation system. Its mixed forest-and-rangeland commitment calls for regeneration of at least 40% of existing degraded areas. The pledge estimates coverage at approximately 232,050 ha for forestry, equal to about 32.5% of current forest cover, and 5.35 million ha for rangelands, about 21.4% of current grassland cover. The latter percentages refer only to degraded forest and rangeland, whereas the land-cover comparisons use each class’s total current area; no timeframe is stated.
